purpose: Capture current-source guidance for the held v507 v8 x2 preparation layer and the v508 live-adapter recovery plan.

source_refresh.relevance: Codex app and CLI release notes inform Windows attachment handling, inline skills/plugins, queued prompt visibility, and CLI 0.139.0 upgrade posture.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Use updated Codex surfaces for status-only diagnostics, but keep exact validation and publication gates unchanged.

source_refresh.relevance: CLI 0.139.0 notes mention direct code-mode web search, richer schema preservation, doctor redaction, and sandbox behavior improvements.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Treat direct web search and richer tool schemas as useful for phase research and MCP compatibility, not as proof that blocked private app lanes are recovered.

source_refresh.relevance: MCP standardizes tool and context integration through explicit protocol surfaces.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Use exposed tool schemas and route metadata as the authority; do not infer hidden callable IDs or force private route discovery.

source_refresh.relevance: Tool exposure depends on named tools and schemas, with external-system actions mediated by explicit tool boundaries.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Only call sibling lanes through exposed safe tools; if a send or wait surface is absent, publish a blocker receipt instead of creating replacements.

source_refresh.source: OWASP Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations
source_refresh.relevance: Agentic systems require threat-model-aware least privilege, access control, monitoring, and safe operational boundaries.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Keep sibling permissions read-only by default, avoid raw private-data publication, and preserve human approval for higher-risk repair or mutation.

source_refresh.source: NVIDIA DGX Spark official product page
source_refresh.relevance: Local agent development benefits from high-memory local AI workstations and a migration path from local prototype to accelerated infrastructure.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Use local-first and status-only patterns as design inspiration, but do not claim the current laptop has DGX-class capability.

source_refresh.source: Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
source_refresh.relevance: Enterprise agent platforms emphasize building, scaling, governing, and optimizing agents grounded in enterprise data.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Map THOS future architecture toward governance, observability, route identity, and managed lifecycle records.

source_refresh.relevance: ADK is positioned for building, debugging, and deploying reliable agents and multi-agent systems.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Use ADK-style lifecycle ideas to shape future runner design, while keeping current repo actions bounded to approved local artifacts.

source_refresh.source: Google Cloud Agent Platform scale guidance
source_refresh.relevance: Production agent scaling requires testing, release management, reliability, and continuous improvement.
source_refresh.operational_takeaway: Carry forward phase gates, retry receipts, watcher cadence, and exact publication checks as reliability primitives.

synthesis.primary_design_rule: Existing route exposure is the source of truth; read-only approval does not bypass route availability or publication guards.
synthesis.security_rule: Least privilege remains the default for all sibling lanes and helpers.
synthesis.phase_rule: v507 v8 x2 may continue as preparation-only while app-lane recovery remains open.
synthesis.research_rule: Current-source research should refine runner design, not inflate claims.
